_note: External logs and artifacts observed daily. Each entry is public, and each subject is a party who keeps a hash log in storage they control themselves. Recording them elsewhere is the thing their own docs say is missing.

subjects.name: f-droid.org
subjects.why: Its own btlog README calls the git repo an imperfect append-only storage mechanism.

subjects.name: dralvia.tech
subjects.why: Their README: 'Does not prove: that this repository is complete. A force push can remove anchors from here... If you care, clone this repository regularly.' This is that, on a schedule.

subjects.name: gammapulse.tech
subjects.why: README: 'If we ever silently edit a historical claim, the chain breaks and the published roots no longer verify.' Their own .ots covers only the first commit, so nothing outside their repo commits to the later roots. Recorded here until that changes.
